summary: Shows utility analysts hourly consumption trends across the smart meter fleet, broken down by rate class and region.
Flags meters reporting usage patterns consistent with tampering or malfunction, queuing them for a field technician visit.
Breaks down a customer's usage by time-of-use rate period, helping the billing team validate charges on a disputed bill.
Tracks battery level and communication status for every smart meter, alerting operations before a meter goes offline entirely.
Lets approved third-party energy management apps pull a customer's consented meter data on a recurring schedule.
Shows dispatchers and the public a live map of reported outages, updated as crews confirm the cause and scope of each one.
Calculates an estimated restoration time for an active outage based on cause, crew availability, and historical repair durations.
Assigns the nearest qualified repair crew to a new outage report and tracks their progress from dispatch to restoration.
Sends affected customers a text or call when an outage is confirmed in their area, followed by restoration updates as they change.
Records the confirmed root cause of each resolved outage, building a history used to prioritize future infrastructure upgrades.
Gives grid operators a real-time view of substation and feeder telemetry pulled from the SCADA system for the whole service territory.
Alerts operators when voltage on a feeder drifts outside its normal operating range, before it trips protective equipment.
Monitors temperature and load data from distribution transformers, flagging units trending toward overload or failure.
Lets operators shift load between feeders to relieve one that's approaching capacity without interrupting service.
Estimates the physical location of a line fault from protective relay data, cutting the time a crew spends searching for it.
Aggregates energy output across every solar site in the portfolio and compares actual production against modeled expectations.
Monitors inverter performance for underperformance or fault codes and opens a maintenance ticket automatically when thresholds are crossed.
Forecasts expected solar output for the coming days using weather data, feeding grid operations planning for renewable intake.
Schedules panel cleaning crews for solar sites based on measured soiling loss, prioritizing the sites losing the most output.
Tracks equipment failures against manufacturer warranty terms and manages the claim process for panels and inverters still under warranty.
Schedules and dispatches demand response events to enrolled customers during peak grid stress periods.
Lets eligible customers enroll their smart thermostat or appliance in a demand response program and set their comfort preferences.
Measures how much load each enrolled customer actually shed during a demand response event compared to their baseline usage.
Calculates the bill credit or incentive payment owed to a customer based on their measured curtailment during an event.
Shows program managers enrollment trends and event participation rates across the demand response customer base.
Calculates a customer's monthly bill by applying the correct tiered or time-of-use rate schedule to their metered usage.
Lets a customer see what their last several bills would have cost under a different available rate plan before switching.
Averages a customer's estimated annual usage into equal monthly payments and true-ups the difference at year end.
Shows a customer how close they are to crossing into a higher usage tier for the current billing period, with days remaining.
Tracks renewable energy credits applied to a customer's account under a green power rate plan and reflects them on the bill.
Gives field technicians their daily work order queue with job details, site access notes, and a way to mark jobs complete from the truck.
Requires a technician to complete a job-specific safety checklist, like lockout-tagout steps, before energized work can be logged as started.
Lets a technician check parts availability at the nearest warehouse or truck stock before heading out to a job that needs a specific component.
Sequences a technician's assigned jobs for the day into the most efficient driving route based on location and job priority.
Lets a technician log labor hours and materials used on a job, feeding directly into work order costing and inventory deduction.
Tracks the company's open positions across power and gas markets, showing net exposure by delivery point and settlement period.
Streams live wholesale market prices from the regional grid operator into the trading desk's screens for real-time decision making.
Reconciles the grid operator's settlement statements against the desk's own trade records, flagging any discrepancy for review.
Watches trader positions against approved risk limits in real time and blocks new trades that would breach the limit.
Schedules physical delivery under long-term power purchase agreements against forecasted demand and confirms nominations with counterparties.
Calculates the company's operational carbon emissions from fuel and electricity data, rolled up for quarterly reporting.
Reports the percentage of delivered energy that came from renewable sources each month, broken down by generation type.
Pre-fills required regulatory emissions disclosure forms from the company's tracked data, ready for compliance team review.
Tracks progress against the company's public emissions reduction targets and projects whether current trends will hit the goal on time.
Collects emissions data from key suppliers each year to build out the company's supply-chain emissions estimate.
Monitors the online status and health of every EV charging station in the network, flagging units that go offline unexpectedly.
Bills a driver for a completed charging session based on energy delivered and the station's posted rate, processing payment automatically.
Shows drivers nearby charging stations with real-time availability so they can plan a stop without arriving to a full station.
Lets a commercial fleet operator reserve charging slots overnight for their vehicles, sequencing charge times to manage total site demand.
Alerts network operations when a charging station reports a hardware fault, generating a service ticket for a field technician.
Forecasts system load for the next 24 to 48 hours to help grid operations plan generation dispatch and reserve margins.
Predicts the expected seasonal peak demand months ahead of time, used for capacity planning and generation procurement.
Adjusts the load forecast in real time as new weather data comes in, since temperature swings are the biggest driver of short-term demand changes.
Breaks the system-wide load forecast down to individual feeders, helping planners identify which parts of the grid need reinforcement first.
Compares past load forecasts against actual demand to measure model accuracy and highlight where the forecasting model needs retuning.
Lets customers view their daily and hourly electricity usage in an easy chart, helping them understand what's driving their bill.
Compares a customer's current bill against the same period last year and explains the main drivers behind any change.
Lets a customer enroll in a renewable energy rate plan or purchase renewable energy certificates directly from their account.
Notifies a customer when their usage is trending toward an unusually high bill partway through the billing cycle.
Sends customers a monthly report comparing their usage to similar homes nearby, with tailored tips to reduce consumption.
